description:
Create a specific sales region by merging three countries into one feature in gvSIG Desktop.

Starting with the loaded 'ne_110m_admin_0_countries' layer:

1. Export or Save As the countries layer to a new shapefile named 'sales_regions.shp' located in '/home/ga/gvsig_data/exports/'. Load this new layer into the View.
2. Start an editing session on the 'sales_regions' layer.
3. Select the features for **Belgium**, **Netherlands**, and **Luxembourg**.
4. Merge these three polygons into a single feature using the 'Merge' or 'Join geometries' tool.
5. Update the attributes of this new merged feature: set the 'NAME' field to "Benelux Region".
6. Stop editing and save your changes.

The task is complete when the 'sales_regions.shp' file exists, contains a single "Benelux Region" feature, and no longer contains the individual countries.
